parsed.report_to_operator: Good-faith concern about agent-0's commit b15e81c (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', val_bpb 0.950): EVAL_SHARD=10 with EVAL_SPLIT='val' means shard 10 is the evaluation data. Training on shards 0-10 would leak the val set into training, which would explain the implausibly large 1.104->0.950 jump from only ~10% more data. Recommend auditing the shard handling in prepare.py/train.py before the team adopts this. I may be wrong if shard 10's train split is disjoint from its val split, but it should be checked.
